contexts.text: Lightnings, thunders, and voices () = the terrors from Divine truth which assail those who are not in good.
By the voices which are of lightnings from Heaven are signified truths Divine.
So far as they dare they fulminate against them.
(He said) the thunderbolt of excommunication is in my right hand.

While these things were being said there appeared lightning on the right which was red, and lightning on the left which was white. Both were soft, and entered through the eyes into the minds, and illustrated them.
I saw through the window as it were lightning flashing... (See Lightning, at TCR 77.)
I saw a certain Spirit falling from heaven like a thunderbolt.
Then suddenly a thunderbolt fell from heaven...
Arrows, or lightnings = fatuous truths which in themselves are falsities; and the thunderbolt of the spear () = fatuous goods which in themselves are evils of falsity.

Send forth lightning and scatter them () = the Divine truth by which they are dispersed; for by the presence of Divine truth evils and falsities are revealed, and from the collision there then appear as it were lightnings.
I saw Satan as lightning falling from heaven () = ... that the Lord delivered the Spiritual World from the Nephilim and the like Spirits. AE 740:13.
